correctness.rationale: For arbitrary field, including characteristic two, the derivation identity on the nondegenerate alternating bracket forces quotient B to satisfy beta_B=c omega. Evaluation S->Sv from sp(V,omega) is surjective for nonzero v (extend a prescribed symmetric bilinear form), giving local=center preserving. Isotropic pair tests force beta_B proportional to omega; independent quotient pairs can match by adjusting the central functional, dependent pairs by changing conformal multiplier. This establishes the three spaces and dimensions 4n^2+2n+1,2n^2+3n+2,2n^2+3n+1. The rank polynomial follows from the elementary block matrix [B 0;f t], with rank r only when t=0 and f is in row(B), giving q^r options; otherwise r+1. Independent F2 dimension-three enumeration gives rank counts 1,25,78,24 (total 128).
